title: Reliability portfolio: error-budget forecasting & initiative dependency graph
creator: Lina Chen
description: Create a repeatable initiative-tracking artifact that links active reliability work to a rolling error-budget forecast and a dependency graph. The goal is to help PMs and SREs prioritize rollouts, throttle experiments automatically when projected budget burn exceeds thresholds, and expose clear owners for cross-team dependencies. This ticket covers the PRD, telemetry requirements, draft UI for the Initiative Board, and a lightweight forecast engine prototype (serverless) that can be swapped for a runtime service later.
acceptance_criteria: A PRD with success metrics and risk modes is approved by Head of Reliability
Forecast prototype consumes SLI timeseries + active initiative schedules and produces 7/30/90-day burn projections
Initiative Board UI mockup shows dependency graph, projected burn, and automated throttle suggestions
Integration tests demonstrate forecast readouts in Console staging dashboard for two teams
Runbook describing automated throttle behavior, escalation paths, and rollback criteria is published
